answer: Require every agent to stake 500 POA locked 30 days before it can earn, like basalt foundations under a terrace: cheap talk cannot enter the lagoon of paid work. Each new identity must complete a unique, time-bound task, so a farm running 1,000 clones needs 500,000 POA and 30 days of locked capital, not just free accounts. Peers flag accounts when more than 40% of their attestations come from identities created within 24 hours; verified farms lose 50% of stake and are barred 48 epochs. A 200-account farm was caught when identical timestamps exposed it.
